start.topic: Perimeter of rectangles, squares and polygons
start.opening: Namaste Kabir, main Asha, aapki AI teacher. Aaj perimeter seekhenge. Aapko rectangles, squares ya polygons mein kaunsa shape pasand hai?

turns.reply: Perimeter yani boundary ki total length: polygon ki sabhi sides ko same unit mein jodte hain. Aap isse Bittu ko kaise batayenge?
Theek hai Kabir—perimeter nikalne ka rule: shape ki har side ki length jodiye. Rectangle ki chaar sides kaun-si hoti hain?
